# Load packages

```{r}
# Install specific versions
# install.packages("data.table")  # Will install latest version (1.16.4)
# install.packages("rlang")       # Will install latest version (1.1.4)

# Load these packages first
library(data.table)
library(rlang)
packageVersion("data.table")
packageVersion("rlang")


# Function to install and load packages 
package_install = function(package_list) {
  for (pkg in package_list) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        install.packages(pkg)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(paste0("Could not install ", pkg, ": ", e))
      })
    }
    # Load the library
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# List of packages
packages = c('tidyverse', 'haven', 'qgcomp', 'dplyr', 'ggplot2', 'moments', 
             'naniar', 'VIM', 'missForest', 'tidymodels', 'purrr', 'gridExtra', 
             'knitr', 'infotheo', 'igraph', 'ggraph', 'lubridate', 'zoo', 
             'ggridges', 'slider', 'stats', 'reshape2', 'broom', 'gridExtra',
             'modelsummary', 'sandwich', 'tidyverse', 'igraph', 'ggraph', 
             'arrow', 'patchwork', 'clubSandwich', 'scales', 'kableExtra')

# Call the package_install function 
package_install(packages)

dir_data <- here::here(paste0("02-modeling/data/"))
```

```{r}
stringency_march_22_may_23  = stringency_averages[, .(state, stringency_march_22_may_23)]
```

# Functions
```{r}
# Function to add stringency. Hard coded relevant exposures inside, to change if selected windows change
add_stringency_to_cope = function(cope_data, stringency_index = "march_15_june_30") {
  # Determine which stringency data and column to use based on the stringency_index parameter
  if (stringency_index == "march_15_june_30") {
    stringency_data = stringency_march_15_june_30
    stringency_column = "stringency_march_15_june_30"  # This is the column name in the data
  } else if (stringency_index == "march_22_may_23") {
    stringency_data = stringency_march_22_may_23
    stringency_column = "stringency_march_22_may_23"
  } else if (stringency_index == "april_12_may_23") {
    stringency_data = stringency_april_12_may_23
    stringency_column = "stringency_april_12_may_23"
  } else {
    stop("Invalid stringency_index. Must be one of 'march_15_june_30', 'march_22_may_23', or 'april_12_may_23'.")
  }
  
  # Create a copy of cope_data to avoid modifying the original
  cope_data_w_stringency = cope_data
  
  # Convert RegionName to character for matching
  region_names_char = as.character(cope_data_w_stringency$RegionName)
  
  # Create a lookup table from state name to stringency value
  state_to_stringency = setNames(
    stringency_data[[stringency_column]],
    stringency_data$state
  )
  
  # Check if all region names are in the stringency data
  missing_regions = setdiff(unique(region_names_char), names(state_to_stringency))
  if (length(missing_regions) > 0) {
    warning("Some regions in cope_data do not have matching stringency data: ", 
            paste(missing_regions, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Add the stringency column to cope_data_w_stringency
  # Use the original stringency column name
  cope_data_w_stringency[[stringency_column]] <- 
    state_to_stringency[region_names_char]
  
  return(cope_data_w_stringency)
}
```

# Loop for exposure windows

```{r}
# Initialize windows
period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627", "20200322_20200523", "20200412_20200523")
suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27", "_March_22_May_23", "_April_12_May_23")
stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30", "march_22_may_23", "april_12_may_23")

# # For check
# period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627")
# suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27")
# stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30")
# i = 1

results_est_list <- list()
results_hicc_list <- list()

cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency <- data.frame()


for (i in seq_along(period_keys)) {
  
  ## Reset train and test flags
  train_data = train_data %>% mutate(train_flag = TRUE)
  test_data = test_data %>% mutate(train_flag = FALSE)
  
  ## Get full data
  full_sample_data <- bind_rows(train_data, test_data)
  
  ## Print period
  print(paste0("Period: ", period_keys[i]))
  
  ## colnames
  all_cols <- names(full_sample_data)
  
  ## non_policy columns
  non_policy_cols <- all_cols[!grepl("^C[1-7]M", all_cols)]
  
  ## Columns that start with C[1-7]M AND end with the target suffix
  policy_cols_this_period <- all_cols[
    grepl(paste0("^C[1-7]M.*", period_keys[i], "$"), all_cols)
  ]

  ## Final set of columns to select
  selected_cols <- c(non_policy_cols, policy_cols_this_period)
  
  ## Subset the dataframe
  full_sample_data_filtered <- full_sample_data[, selected_cols]
  
  ## Replace old suffix with new in the relevant column names
  new_names <- str_replace(policy_cols_this_period, paste0(period_keys[i], "$"), sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]))
  
  ## Apply the renaming in the dataframe
  names(full_sample_data_filtered)[names(full_sample_data_filtered) %in% policy_cols_this_period] <- new_names
  
  ## Calling function to add stringency index to df 
  cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency = add_stringency_to_cope(full_sample_data_filtered, stringency_keys[i])
  
  ## New age groups
  cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency = cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency %>%
    mutate(
      age_group = case_when(
        age_2020 < 44.5  ~ "18-44", 
        age_2020 >= 44.5 & age_2020 < 65 ~ "45-64", 
        TRUE ~ "65+"
      )
    )
  cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency$age_group = as.factor(cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency$age_group)
  
  ## Get train and test splits for modeling
  train_data_df <- cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency %>% filter(train_flag == TRUE)
  test_data_df <- cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency %>% filter(train_flag == FALSE)
  
  ## Create window wise sets
  assign(paste0("train_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i])), copy(train_data_df))
  assign(paste0("test_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i])), copy(test_data_df))
  assign(paste0("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", tolower(suffixes[i])), copy(cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency))
}
```
